name: Yudhiṣṭhira
bio: Eldest Pāṇḍava, son of Dharma. Devoted to truth — and undone by the dice.

name: Bhīma
bio: Second Pāṇḍava, son of the wind. Immense strength, immense appetite, fierce in love and in anger.

name: Arjuna
bio: Third Pāṇḍava, son of Indra. The peerless archer to whom Kṛṣṇa spoke the Gītā.

name: Draupadī
bio: Born from the sacrificial fire, wife of the five Pāṇḍavas. Her question in the hall is never answered.

name: Kṛṣṇa
bio: Prince of the Yādavas, Arjuna’s friend and charioteer, worshipped as an avatar of Viṣṇu.

name: Karṇa
bio: Kuntī’s secret firstborn, raised by a charioteer. Generous beyond measure, loyal to Duryodhana until death.

name: Duryodhana
bio: Eldest Kaurava. Proud, generous to friends, consumed by envy of his cousins.

name: Duḥśāsana
bio: Second Kaurava. He dragged Draupadī into the hall.

name: Gāndhārī
bio: Queen of Hastināpura, blindfolded by choice for life; mother of a hundred sons.

name: Abhimanyu
bio: Arjuna’s son by Subhadrā, Kṛṣṇa’s nephew; the boy who broke into the Cakravyūha.
